svg.title: Two zeros, then one yes
svg.desc: Two fan-shaped gauges stand on two plates with a gap between them, joined by one bar across the gap. Each scale has been turned until the tongue at its zero touches a post on its own plate, the stop, both lit teal. The two needles point at the same mark on their scales, and both lamps glow magenta, away from the dashed outlines where they were first assumed to be.
